question: In citizens_bank_financials.csv, compute the year-over-year growth in total deposits (DEP) between REPDTE 20220930 and REPDTE 20230930 as a percentage, rounded to 2 decimals.
solve_py:
import os, pandas as pd
D=os.environ.get('DATA_DIR','/app/data')
f=pd.read_csv(D+'/citizens_bank_financials.csv').set_index('REPDTE');print(round((f.loc[20230930,'DEP']/f.loc[20220930,'DEP']-1)*100,2))
